name: Brigid Baeli
description: Brigid Baeli is a kithkin archer of Kinsbaile, the Hero of Kinsbaile, who helped bring down Oona and later trains the city watch in Goldmeadow.

summary.text: Brigid Baeli is a kithkin archer of Kinsbaile, the Hero of Kinsbaile, who helped bring down Oona and later trains the city watch in Goldmeadow.

bio.text: Gaddock Teeg assigned her to accompany Ashling and later ordered her to capture Rhys, but Colfenor's altered message made her nearly drown Ashling instead.

bio.text: Racked with self-reproach, she left Kinsbaile to atone, and she survived the shift into Shadowmoor intact while holding Sygg's Crescent.

"Brigid Baeli", section "A new legacy". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

bio.text: She once sailed as a pirate under Sygg, and she kept her friendship with Maralen over the years.

citations.text: "The Legends of Lorwyn Eclipsed" by Neale LaPlante Johnson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Jan 2026.
"Brigid Baeli", section "An unfamiliar world". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

status.text: As of the latest stories, she is alive and trains the Goldmeadow city watch, after the Shadowmoor transformation seen in the Lorwyn Eclipsed episodes.

citations.text: "The Legends of Lorwyn Eclipsed" by Neale LaPlante Johnson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Jan 2026.

citations.text: "Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 6: Full of Hateful Fantasies" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Dec 2025.

timeline.summary: Ashling takes a messenger job from Colfenor, gains the Vendilion clique and Brigid Baeli as companions at Kinsbaile.
timeline.quote: Ashling had accepted a seemingly innocuous messenger job from the treefolk sage Colfenor

citation.text: "Ashling", section "Pilgrimage". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Brigid drenches Ashling, nearly killing her; the greater elemental appears, rekindles her fire and sets Colfenor ablaze.
timeline.quote: A surge of energy from the elemental's blessing rekindled her fire and set Colfenor ablaze, obliterating the yew.

citation.text: "Ashling", section "Pilgrimage". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Gaddock Teeg assigns Brigid to accompany Ashling in finding the Gilt-Leaf elf Rhys.
timeline.quote: Brigid became embroiled in an increasingly complex adventure when Gaddock Teeg assigned her to accompany a flamekin messenger named Ashling on her mission to find a Gilt-Leaf elf named Rhys .

citation.text: "Brigid Baeli", section "An unexpected adventure". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Teeg orders Brigid to capture Rhys as a gift for the Gilt-Leaf commander Nath.
timeline.quote: Teeg ordered Brigid to capture Rhys and bring him back as a gift to Nath.

citation.text: "Brigid Baeli", section "An unexpected adventure". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Manipulated by Colfenor's message, Brigid nearly drowns Ashling and attacks Rhys at the Murmuring Bosk.
timeline.quote: Brigid nearly drowned Ashling on the banks of the Murmuring Bosk to snuff out her fire, attacked Rhys, and escaped to Kinsbaile with an unconscious, dying Ashling in tow.

citation.text: "Brigid Baeli", section "An unexpected adventure". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Rhys kills Nath, ending the elvish threat, and Colfenor admits he ordered Brigid's attack to coincide with his rebirth.
timeline.quote: the elvish threat to Kinsbaile was negated when Rhys killed Taercenn Nath in hand-to-hand combat

citation.text: "Brigid Baeli", section "An unexpected adventure". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Filled with self-reproach, Brigid leaves Kinsbaile during the Festival of Tales to atone.
timeline.quote: Brigid wanted to atone for her actions and saw the opportunity to leave her life in Kinsbaile behind.

citation.text: "Brigid Baeli", section "A new legacy". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Brigid works as a decoy to free Brion and Kiel from Gilt-Leaf hunters.
timeline.quote: She worked as a decoy to aid the liberation of Brion and Kiel from the Gilt-Leaf hunters that had captured them when they laid siege to Kinsbaile

citation.text: "Brigid Baeli", section "A new legacy". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Holding Sygg's Crescent, Brigid meets the Source of the Wanderwine and survives the shift into Shadowmoor intact.
timeline.quote: which enabled her to survive the change between Lorwyn to Shadowmoor with her memories, abilities, and physical image intact.

citation.text: "Brigid Baeli", section "A new legacy". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Brigid knocks Sygg out to save Jack's life.
timeline.quote: When Sygg wanted to kill Jack, Brigid knocked him out to save Jack's life.

citation.text: "Brigid Baeli", section "An unfamiliar world". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Brigid gives Jack her magical wingbow.
timeline.quote: She gave Jack her magical wingbow, capable of flight.

citation.text: "Brigid Baeli", section "An unfamiliar world". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Brigid lives in Mistmeadow and helps defend it from Ashling the Destroyer.
timeline.quote: Later, Brigid came to live in Mistmeadow and helped to defend the city from Ashling the Destroyer.

citation.text: "Brigid Baeli", section "An unfamiliar world". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Maralen takes Ashling's elemental power, then betrays Brigid above Cayr Ulios.
timeline.quote: Maralen snapped the Crescent from Brigid's neck and sent her falling.

citation.text: "Brigid Baeli", section "An unfamiliar world". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: After the Great Aurora turns the plane into Shadowmoor, a coalition including Maralen and Rhys defeats Oona.
timeline.quote: Oona was defeated by a coalition consisting of Maralen, an elf named Rhys

citation.text: "Lorwyn-Shadowmoor", section "Age of Oona". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The Vendilion clique abducts Maralen; Sygg reaches the Bosk with Rhys, Ashling and Brigid.
timeline.quote: Sygg took the company through the Dark Meanders

citation.text: "Sygg Gauhren Gyllalla Syllvar", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Brigid attacks Ashling, ensnares Sygg and Rhys in a net, and Sygg frees them with acid.
timeline.quote: Sygg managed to free them both from the kithkin hero's trap

citation.text: "Sygg Gauhren Gyllalla Syllvar", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Brigid takes the Crescent of Morningtide as the Great Aurora sweeps the world.
timeline.quote: unfortunately, Brigid took it as the Great Aurora swept across the world.

citation.text: "Sygg Gauhren Gyllalla Syllvar", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The clique secretly spies on Rhys, Brigid and Maralen and reports to Oona.
timeline.quote: the trio was, in actuality, secretly spying on them and reporting their movements to Oona

citation.text: "Vendilion clique", section "Assignment". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Ashling, Brigid and the Vendilion clique find Rhys with a message from Colfenor.
timeline.quote: the flamekin carried a message for him

citation.text: "Rhys", section "Siring the Sapling". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Brigid, manipulated by Colfenor, lies about Ashling and Sygg and escapes to Kinsbaile with Ashling.
timeline.quote: Brigid, who was manipulated into the act by Colfenor, escaped to Kinsbaile with Ashling.

citation.text: "Rhys", section "Siring the Sapling". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Endry is sent to save Brigid and then guide the sapling while his sisters serve Maralen.
timeline.quote: Endry was dispatched to save Brigid Baeli from Gilt-Leaf hunters

citation.text: "Vendilion clique", section "Serving a new mistress". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Maralen, Brigid, Captain Sygg and the Source of the Wanderbrine subdue the Destroyer; Maralen gains the elemental power instead of Oona.
timeline.quote: but Maralen, aided by the scroll of Rosheen Meanderer , gained the power instead

citation.text: "Ashling", section "Advent of the Destroyer". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Colfenor and Rhys reunite in Kinsbaile, and Colfenor sends him to plant his seed cone at Murmuring Bosk.
timeline.quote: Colfenor tasked Rhys with traveling to Murmuring Bosk

citation.text: "Colfenor", section "Reunion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Rhys, Ashling and Brigid find Murmuring Bosk leveled and burned, and Rhys plants the cone anyway.
timeline.quote: Rhys planted the cone anyway, performing a ritual to ensure its growth.

citation.text: "Colfenor", section "Reunion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Colfenor learns Brigid was meant to capture Rhys and redirects her to abduct Ashling so as to end his own life.
timeline.quote: Colfenor covertly redirected Brigid to abduct Ashling instead.

citation.text: "Colfenor", section "Reunion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Ashling is rekindled by a greater elemental and her fire engulfs Colfenor, who dies as the last yew despite Rhys's efforts.
timeline.quote: the last yew burned brightly to his death

citation.text: "Colfenor", section "Reunion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Colfenor's sapling rises one day after his death, greeting the company as her seedfather's heir.
timeline.quote: the young tree had grown, awakened, and "risen" merely one day after Colfenor's death

citation.text: "Colfenor", section "Legacy". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Oona tries to take Ashling's elemental power but is thwarted by Maralen, Brigid Baeli and Sygg, then retreats to Cayr Ulios and drains the elves.
timeline.quote: She tried to take the elemental power of Ashling , but was thwarted by Maralen

citation.text: "Oona", section "Dethroned". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Sygg helps Maralen and Brigid ambush Ashling; Maralen betrays him and keeps the Crescent.
timeline.quote: She kept the Crescent and united the power of two greater elementals, fire and water, in herself.

citation.text: "Sygg Gauhren Gyllalla Syllvar", section "After the Great Aurora". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Maralen is revealed to be a twin of Oona, defies her, and takes the Crescent of Morningtide from Brigid Baeli.
timeline.quote: Later, she took the Crescent of Morningtide from Brigid Baeli and challenged Oona to face her in a direct fight.

citation.text: "Maralen", section "Ascension". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Oona is defeated by Maralen, Rhys, Brigid, Sygg, Ashling and Colfenor's sapling, though her consciousness survives.
timeline.quote: Though Oona was defeated and her body was destroyed, her consciousness remains hidden

citation.text: "Rhys", section "Oona's defeat". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Oko cures Maralen with dawnglow; Eirdu appears to offset Isilu and Rhys is at peace.
timeline.quote: Oko acquired a vial of dawnglow

citation.text: "Rhys", section "Last task". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Brigid Baeli meets the students and offers them hospitality as the night erases their Omenpath.
timeline.quote: the kithkin offered them hospitality

citation.text: "Sanar", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Isilu walks past Goldmeadow, plunging it into Shadowmoor, and the students flee toward Glen Elendra.
timeline.quote: Isilu walked past the village, plunging a place that had been in Lorwyn for years into the darkness of Shadowmoor.

citation.text: "Sanar", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The group finds Ashling at the Stinkdrinker warren and sets out to track Isilu, but is halted by Brigid and the Shadowmoor kithkin.
timeline.quote: The four set out to track down Isilu

citation.text: "Sanar", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: After the Great Aurora turns the plane to Shadowmoor, a coalition of Maralen, Rhys, Brigid, Sygg, Ashling and Colfenor defeats Oona.
timeline.quote: Oona was defeated by a coalition consisting of Maralen, an elf named Rhys, a kithkin named Brigid, a merrow named Sygg, a flamekin named Ashling, and a treefolk sapling named Colfenor.

citation.text: "Planeswalker's Guide to Lorwyn Eclipsed" by Neale LaPlante Johnson, DK Billins, Laurel Pratt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Sep 2025.

timeline.summary: A stout archer waves the students toward her across patches of darkness and leads them into an ash forest.
timeline.quote: Follow me,

citation.work: Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 2: Shake Off Slumber
citation.text: "Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 2: Shake Off Slumber" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 9 Dec 2025.

timeline.summary: Brigid asks the students who they are and winces when Abigale's telepathy enters her mind, since they are not part of the thoughtweft.
timeline.quote: You're not part of the thoughtweft. You're not meant to be there.

citation.work: Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 2: Shake Off Slumber
citation.text: "Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 2: Shake Off Slumber" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 9 Dec 2025.

timeline.summary: Brigid introduces herself, explains that people tumble into Lorwyn since the metal invasion, and identifies the beast as Isilu.
timeline.quote: My name is Brigid Baeli, hero of Kinsbaile, and I'm pleased to welcome you to Lorwyn.

citation.work: Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 2: Shake Off Slumber
citation.text: "Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 2: Shake Off Slumber" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 9 Dec 2025.

timeline.summary: Brigid says Isilu should be sleeping, not stomping through Lorwyn and seeding Shadowmoor in their territories.
timeline.quote: It's supposed to be sleeping right now, not stomping through Lorwyn and seeding Shadowmoor in our territories.

citation.work: Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 2: Shake Off Slumber
citation.text: "Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 2: Shake Off Slumber" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 9 Dec 2025.

timeline.summary: Tam asks Brigid for a place to go and Brigid agrees to take them somewhere.
timeline.quote: I think I do, yes,

citation.work: Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 2: Shake Off Slumber
citation.text: "Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 2: Shake Off Slumber" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 9 Dec 2025.

timeline.summary: Brigid leads the students toward Goldmeadow, saying not just anyone could get them there.
timeline.quote: But not just anyone could get you to Goldmeadow

citation.work: Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 3: Aweary of This Moon
citation.text: "Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 3: Aweary of This Moon" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Dec 2025.

timeline.summary: The students arrive at Goldmeadow and Brigid takes them into the meeting hall, saying her mangled thoughtweft connection makes the locals nervous.
timeline.quote: I make the locals a bit nervous, what with my connection to the thoughtweft all mangled up and half-severed.

citation.work: Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 3: Aweary of This Moon
citation.text: "Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 3: Aweary of This Moon" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Dec 2025.

timeline.summary: The students explain how they arrived; Brigid identifies the creature as a faerie and says she is a close friend of Queen Maralen.
timeline.quote: I'm sort of a close friend of their queen.

citation.work: Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 3: Aweary of This Moon
citation.text: "Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 3: Aweary of This Moon" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Dec 2025.

timeline.summary: The blue faerie reappears in the meeting hall and laughs until alarm bells drown it out, then flies away.
timeline.quote: the little blue faerie from before, which had flown in through a window and was now hovering in front of him.

citation.work: Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 3: Aweary of This Moon
citation.text: "Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 3: Aweary of This Moon" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Dec 2025.

timeline.summary: Brigid tells the students to flee and explains how to reach Glen Elendra, warning them not to listen to anyone who begs them to turn around.
timeline.quote: When I step through this door, you run, you understand me?

citation.work: Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 3: Aweary of This Moon
citation.text: "Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 3: Aweary of This Moon" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Dec 2025.

timeline.summary: Night-side figures pull Brigid into the darkness, transforming her, and she fights alongside them against her former allies.
timeline.quote: when she opened her eyes again, they were full moon-bright, filled with a light that had nothing to do with the day.

citation.work: Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 3: Aweary of This Moon
citation.text: "Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 3: Aweary of This Moon" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Dec 2025.

timeline.summary: The transformed kithkin of Goldmeadow led by Brigid surround and herd the party.
timeline.quote: the transformed Brigid at the front of their pack.

citation.work: Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 5: If We Shadows
citation.text: "Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 5: If We Shadows" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Dec 2025.

timeline.summary: A line of elf torches appears while Isilu closes in, and the kithkin ready to fight.
timeline.quote: And all the while, Isilu came closer, the living night descending on the drowning dregs of day.

citation.work: Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 5: If We Shadows
citation.text: "Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 5: If We Shadows" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Dec 2025.

timeline.summary: A disarmed elf becomes a Shadowmoor elf and defects, prompting Brigid and the kithkin to charge.
timeline.quote: Brigid seemed to take her defection as a cue

citation.work: Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 6: Full of Hateful Fantasies
citation.text: "Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 6: Full of Hateful Fantasies" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Dec 2025.

timeline.summary: Brigid and Sygg are part of the group that brought down Oona; Brigid once sailed as a pirate under Sygg.
timeline.quote: A principled member of the group responsible for Oona's downfall

citation.text: "The Legends of Lorwyn Eclipsed" by Neale LaPlante Johnson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Jan 2026.

timeline.summary: The students meet the kithkin Brigid Baeli, and night erases the Omenpath they came through; she offers them hospitality.
timeline.quote: She introduced herself as Brigid Baeli .

citation.text: "Abigale", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Brigid takes them to Goldmeadow, where Isilu turns the village to Shadowmoor and they flee toward Glen Elendra to seek Maralen.
timeline.quote: Isilu walked past the village, turning a place that had been in Lorwyn for years into Shadowmoor.

citation.text: "Abigale", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Years after the Phyrexian invasion, Brigid finds four stranded Arcavios students and leads them to Goldmeadow.
timeline.quote: she found four students from the plane of Arcavios , Abigale , Tamira , Kirol , and Sanar , who had been stranded by an instanced Omenpath.

citation.text: "Brigid Baeli", section "Eclipsed". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Oko brings Isilu to Goldmeadow; the town becomes Mistmeadow and Brigid becomes her Shadowmoor self.
timeline.quote: for the first time in her long and storied life, Brigid became her Shadowmoor self.

citation.text: "Brigid Baeli", section "Eclipsed". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Rhys is freed from his pact with Maralen and fades away into the daylight.
timeline.quote: then watched as Rhys was freed from the magical pact he had forged with Maralen decades ago and faded away into the daylight.

citation.text: "Brigid Baeli", section "Eclipsed". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Brigid Baeli meets the students and offers them hospitality after the night erases the Omenpath.
timeline.quote: the kithkin offered them hospitality

citation.text: "Kirol", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Isilu walks past Goldmeadow, turning it into Shadowmoor; Brigid tells the students to flee toward Maralen's palace.
timeline.quote: Isilu walked past the village, turning a place that had been in Lorwyn for years into Shadowmoor.

citation.text: "Kirol", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The kithkin Brigid Baeli introduces herself and offers the students hospitality.
timeline.quote: She introduced herself as Brigid Baeli .

citation.text: "Tam", section "Strixhaven". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Isilu turns Goldmeadow to Shadowmoor and the students flee; Kirol is kidnapped by an elven hunter.
timeline.quote: However, Isilu walked past the village, plunging a place that had been in Lorwyn for years into the darkness of Shadowmoor.

citation.text: "Tam", section "Strixhaven". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The elves subdue Gaddock Teeg and Colfenor sends a forged message to Brigid.
timeline.quote: Colfenor sent a forged message to Brigid Baeli

citation.text: "Festival of Tales", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Brigid fights Ashling in the Murmuring Bosk and lies to Rhys.
timeline.quote: the kithkin hero lied to Rhys that Ashling had gone mad

citation.text: "Festival of Tales", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Brigid and Rhys join forces to rescue Ashling.
timeline.quote: Brigid and Rhys decided to join forces

citation.text: "Festival of Tales", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Teeg orders Brigid to bring Rhys back subdued to win Nath's favor, but Colfenor alters the message so Brigid targets Ashling, foiling the plot.
timeline.quote: However, Colfenor modified the message bound for Brigid and had her target Ashling instead

citation.text: "Gaddock Teeg", section "Political suicide". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Jack kills a merrow looter and is saved from Sygg by Brigid, who gives him a wingbow.
timeline.quote: Jack killed one of the Merrow looters and was saved from Sygg's wrath by Brigid's intervention

citation.text: "Jack Chierdagh", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Jack, Brigid and the Wilt-Leaf elves help defend the doun against Ashling the Destroyer.
timeline.quote: Ashling the Destroyer attacked Mistmeadow

citation.text: "Jack Chierdagh", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The sapling survives the Great Aurora with memories intact and, with Maralen, Brigid and Ashling, plays a role in Oona's downfall.
timeline.quote: played an important role in Oona's downfall

citation.text: "Sapling of Colfenor", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

citation.work: Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 2: Shake Off Slumber
citation.text: "Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 2: Shake Off Slumber" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 9 Dec 2025.

relations.note: Brigid says she is a close friend of the queen.
relations.quote: I'm sort of a close friend of their queen.

citation.work: Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 3: Aweary of This Moon
citation.text: "Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 3: Aweary of This Moon" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Dec 2025.

relations.note: Isilu's darkness transforms Brigid's village and turns her to the night side.
